# Lisbon Spring Trip Plan: 5 Days, 2 Adults

A relaxed Lisbon itinerary with museums, food markets, and one easy coastal day trip, designed to stay under **12 km walking per day** and avoid late nights. Estimated total on-the-ground spend is kept within your **€1,800 budget for 2 adults**.

## Day-by-Day Lisbon Itinerary and Budget

### Day 1: Baixa, Chiado, and a Classic Welcome to Lisbon
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, and do a gentle walk through **Baixa** and **Rossio**; keep it to central streets and viewpoints.
- Afternoon: Visit **Carmo Convent** and the **Santa Justa area**, then browse **Chiado** and a café stop.
- Food: Lunch at a traditional tascas spot; dinner in Chiado with simple seafood or grilled fish.
- Walking target: **6–8 km**
- Estimated cost for 2: **€170–€230**
  - Meals: €80–€110
  - Local transport: €10–€20
  - Admissions/coffee/snacks: €20–€40
  - Miscellaneous: €60–€60

### Day 2: Alfama, Tile Art, and a Market Lunch
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg
- Morning: Start at **Lisbon Cathedral** area and explore **Alfama** at an easy pace; use the tram or taxi for the steepest parts.
- Afternoon: Visit **Museu Nacional do Azulejo** for a strong museum stop, then return to central Lisbon.
- Food: Have lunch at **Time Out Market** or a similar food hall for broad choice and easy pacing.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/8/83/Lobster%2C_Time_Out_Market_Lisboa_%2850661858143%29.jpg Alt=Food: Have lunch at **Time Out Market** or a similar food hall for broad choice and easy pacing, Lisbon, Portugal
- Walking target: **7–10 km**
- Estimated cost for 2: **€190–€260**
  - Meals: €90–€130
  - Local transport: €10–€20
  - Admissions: €20–€40
  - Miscellaneous: €70–€70

### Day 3: Belém Museums and Riverfront Classics
- Morning: Head to **Belém** for **Jerónimos Monastery** and the **Belém riverside**.
- Afternoon: Add one museum such as the **MAAT** or **Coach Museum**, depending on your interests and energy.
- Food: Stop for **pastéis de nata** in Belém and keep dinner simple back in the city.
- Walking target: **8–11 km**
- Estimated cost for 2: **€210–€290**
  - Meals: €90–€120
  - Local transport: €10–€20
  - Admissions: €35–€60
  - Snacks/treats: €15–€25
  - Miscellaneous: €60–€65

### Day 4: Easy Coastal Day Trip to Cascais
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- Morning: Take the train to **Cascais** for an easy seaside day with low-effort walking.
- Afternoon: Enjoy the promenade, marina, and beach views; if you want a short add-on, visit **Boca do Inferno** by local transport or a short taxi ride.
- Food: Seafood lunch by the water, then a light early dinner back in Lisbon.
- Walking target: **5–9 km**
- Estimated cost for 2: **€180–€260**
  - Train/local transport: €20–€35
  - Meals: €100–€140
  - Snacks/ice cream/coffee: €20–€30
  - Miscellaneous: €40–€55

### Day 5: Museums, a Food Market Finish, and Departure Buffer
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- Morning: Choose one final museum, such as the **Calouste Gulbenkian Museum**, for a calm last cultural stop.
- Afternoon: Do a final food market lunch or casual grazing stop, then return to the hotel to pack and rest.
- Food: Keep the last dinner flexible and close to your accommodation.
- Walking target: **4–7 km**
- Estimated cost for 2: **€150–€220**
  - Meals: €80–€110
  - Local transport: €10–€20
  - Admissions: €15–€30
  - Miscellaneous: €45–€60

## Budget Fit for the Full Trip

| Category | Estimated Total for 2 | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Accommodation | €650–€900 | Mid-range hotel or apartment, 4 nights |
| Meals and drinks | €430–€620 | Mix of markets, cafés, and casual dinners |
| Local transport | €50–€90 | Metro, tram, taxi for hills, and Cascais train |
| Admissions | €90–€170 | 3–5 museums/monuments |
| Snacks, coffee, extras | €90–€140 | Pastries, water, small purchases |
| Total | **€1,310–€1,920** | Aim for the lower-middle range to stay within budget |

**Best budget target:** about **€1,550–€1,700 total** for two adults, leaving a cushion for one nicer meal or extra admissions.

## Spring Packing Checklist for Lisbon

- Light jacket or trench coat
- Compact umbrella
- Comfortable walking shoes with grip
- 2–3 breathable tops
- 1–2 light sweaters or cardigans
- Long pants or jeans
- Scarf for breezy evenings
- Sunglasses and sunscreen
- Small day bag or crossbody bag
- Reusable water bottle
- Portable charger
- Light rain layer
- Medication and basic first aid items
- Smart-casual outfit for dinners
- Swimwear only if you want a spa or beach option
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/3c/Beach_near_Lisbon_Portugal%2C_1994..jpg Alt=Swimwear only if you want a spa or beach option, Lisbon, Portugal
